'''Embersteel''' was a metallic compound that formed when metallic ores were melted by [[Magma/Legends|lava]] vents, warped by [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] electromagnetic fields, and then instantly cooled by Hoth's icy [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]]. During the [[Galactic War]], [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] hired several individuals to collect embersteel as they suspected it would be useful in the construction of [[Plasma cannon/Legends|plasma cannons]].
